brief: One-storey hipped-roof farm cottage in white clapboard with two tall red brick chimneys rising through a dark brown asphalt roof, a thin bracketed cornice at the eaves and tall narrow windows. A small hip-roofed porch on slim turned posts with scroll brackets sits in the front corner, with a second little porch on the left end. In the example every opening is boarded with plywood; here the family still lives in it but it is tired, with peeling paint. It sits in long grass beside a white gable-roofed dairy barn with rooftop ventilators, a domed silo and a steel windmill, under big cottonwoods and cedars. (Hipped one-storey cottage; nearest archetype is workers_cottage.)
